key_expressions: Can you help me for a moment?,
I don’t know how to do this.,

A: Can you help me for a moment?
This part isn’t working, so I’m stuck.
If you have time, could you take a quick look?
B: Sure, what’s the issue?
Ah, this kind of problem happens a lot.
Okay, let’s check it together. We can fix it quickly.

A: Sorry, but how do I do this?
Even with the instructions, I still don’t get it.
Could you show me how?
B: Yeah, this is confusing at first.
It took me some time to understand it too.
I’ll explain it step by step. You’ll get used to it soon.

A: I think my bag zipper is broken.
I tried fixing it myself, but it got worse.
Can you take a look at it?
B: Let me see—where is it stuck?
Oh, it’s twisted a bit. That’s why it wouldn’t close.
Hold on, if I adjust it like this… it works again!

A: My phone suddenly turned off.
It doesn’t seem to charge either.
Do you know why this might happen?
B: Oh, that must’ve surprised you.
The cable might be the problem.
Try using a different charger once.

A: Excuse me, can I ask for directions?
My map app keeps showing something strange.
Do you know where ○○ Station is around here?
B: Sure, what are you looking for?
Ah, that app glitches sometimes.
○○ Station is a bit to the right from here.

A: My computer suddenly froze.
No matter what I press, nothing works.
What should I do in this situation?
B: Yeah, that can be stressful.
First, try turning it off and on again.
If that doesn’t work, it might be an update issue.

A: My bag is too heavy to carry.
The stairs make it even harder.
Could you help me lift it a little?
B: Sure, I’ll help you!
Yeah, stairs make it really tough.
Put it down here for a moment, it’ll be easier.

A: The door won’t open properly.
The handle feels strange.
Could you check it for me?
B: Let me try opening it.
Hmm, the handle is a bit loose.
If you tighten it, it will open smoothly again.

A: I don’t know how to fold this.
No matter what I do, it doesn’t look right.
Could you show me once?
B: Sure. Everyone finds this tricky at first.
You have to remember the folding order.
If you do it like this, it keeps the shape nicely!

A: I dropped this earlier. Do you think it can be fixed?
It looks fine on the outside, but I’m still worried.
If you’re not busy, could you check it?
B: Let me take a look.
Fortunately, nothing seems seriously damaged.
Yeah, this can be repaired. You can still use it!
